video_title: Why Rajon Rondo Calls Philadelphia a BRILLIANT Move for LeBron

quotes.speaker: Rajon Rondo
quotes.summary_phrase: Rajon Rondo calls Philadelphia a brilliant move for LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: He has arguably the young best point guard in the game. I think he averaged 30 points a game.
quotes.quote: Brilliant move. He has arguably the young best point guard in the game. I think he averaged 30 points a game this year. Joel Embiid is the king on the chessboard. He has all the right pieces to make the right moves. We all know he is a great basketball mind, one of the greatest basketball minds to play the game. If you give him these type of pieces to play with, I am an early bet with them being the favorites to win in my book.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson and Rajon Rondo on Jalen Brown as the final piece
quotes.excerpt: I said that Jalen Brown was the final piece of the puzzle.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: I feel like there is an echo in here. Though we said the exact same thing. I am like, let's strip it all away. I said that Jalen Brown was the final piece of the puzzle. He might have taken his time, but he was like, I can get a top-five wing right here that is a two-way player. I got that point guard up there. And for me, it is like LeBron does a great job as well as anybody of the puzzle pieces. But I am like, Jalen Brown was the final puzzle piece.

text_blocks.speaker: Rajon Rondo
text_blocks.text: Top-five point guard. Don't say top-five point guard.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: I said that point guard. I said that point guard, right? Wherever you want, and I am being respectful. You put him wherever you want. And for me, it is like LeBron does a great job as well as anybody of the puzzle pieces. But I am like, Jalen Brown was the final puzzle piece. If they would have added LeBron to Paul George, he wasn't doing that. LeBron wasn't going to go do that. Thank you. So, one, Jalen Brown, he is like, wait, y'all got Jalen Brown. And we ain't talking about Anthony Simons, we ain't talking about V.J. Edgecombe. We ain't talking about those scoring machines and athletic like V.J. Listen, you ain't got to shoot no more shots. When I drive, you cut back door.

quotes.speaker: Rajon Rondo
quotes.summary_phrase: Rajon Rondo on Jaylen Brown's motivation and potential impact
quotes.excerpt: The disrespect he has had throughout the summer, he has so much to prove.
quotes.quote: A pissed off Jaylen Brown. The disrespect he has had throughout the summer, him, when you get players in that type of mode or they are coming off a season like that he has had and I got he has so much to prove and come on man, it is going to be scary for the league.

quotes.speaker: Rajon Rondo
quotes.summary_phrase: Rajon Rondo evaluates Golden State, Miami, and Cleveland as contenders
quotes.excerpt: Golden State, they are too old. LeBron would have had to play too much.
quotes.quote: Other teams that they don't fit. No disrespect to anybody but obviously Golden State, they are too old. LeBron would have had to play too much, it would have been too much on his plate. To me, Miami doesn't have enough shooting at all, so they won't be difficult to kind of get with in the playoffs. And then, what was the other team? I guess Cleveland maybe? So, no, I don't see that. That's not a good fit. Him, James, and Donovan, no, that's not a good fit. But Maxey, who always plays without the ball, the way that he can shoot the basketball, Anthony Simons, like we mentioned, we mentioned RJ, one of my favorite underrated guards in the league coming off the bench. I mean, it is going to be crazy. And and let's not talk about the man in charge, my fault, Nick Nurse.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on the potential of the Tyrese Maxey and LeBron James pick-and-roll
quotes.excerpt: Can y'all imagine what that is going to look like next year, that pick-and-roll action?
quotes.quote: Can y'all imagine what that is going to look like next year, that pick-and-roll action? Because see, everybody keeps talking about, I am actually talking about Tyrese Maxey and LeBron James. I am talking about LeBron the transition of what he has been doing of late, like, yes, yes, let's not act like LeBron and Tyrese like you already can't stop Tyrese Maxey from getting downhill. And you are talking about a guy that loves, that knows how to set a perfect screen, but knows also how to play that damn roller spot.
